tools.name: show_risk_map
tools.description: Shows an interactive map in clients that render apps (Claude, ChatGPT): this week's forecast risk, hazard events and official warnings for a place, several places side by side, one event (its area, a storm's cone and track) or the whole world; layer opens it on rain, temperature or wind instead. A c

tools.name: get_map_events
tools.description: The hazard events the interactive map loads when the reader pans or zooms to a new view. The map calls it in clients that display it; to list the hazards near a place, use get_hazards_near.

tools.name: get_map_warnings
tools.description: The official warnings the interactive map draws over a view: each hazard's edge at each class and its symbols, at the view's zoom. The map calls it in clients that display it; to list the warnings near a place, use get_hazards_near.

tools.name: get_map_event
tools.description: One hazard event the interactive map opens when the reader taps a warning's area or a storm's cone: the event, or none when it is no longer listed. The map calls it in clients that display it; to list the hazards near a place, use get_hazards_near.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description:
Candidate places for a name, best match first, each with coordinates, full name and kind (city, island, volcano...).

Call it only when a name is ambiguous (several Springfields) or one place is used in several calls: every place tool takes a name itself and uses its best match. GeoNames gazetteer i

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description:
This week's weather and extreme-weather risk at a place, day by day: temperature, rain, wind and each day's risk class (Very low, Low, Medium, High, Critical) with the hazard behind it and why. Heat and cold are graded on UTCI, the felt temperature outdoors.

Use for the next 7 days: "will it storm

tools.name: get_climate_profile
tools.description: Long-term climate risk of one place or property in depth, from 57 global layers: river and coastal flood depth of a 100-year flood now, 2050 and 2080; sea level rise; extreme heat and cold days; heavy rain; drought; water stress; wildfire; warming and rainfall change to 2050 and 2080 with the models

tools.name: get_climate_table
tools.description: A list of sites, a portfolio, addresses or spreadsheet rows screened in one call: the long-term layers of get_climate_profile at up to 200 places, as a table, a row per place and a column per layer and band. By default the headline exposures: river and coastal flood depth, sea level rise, heat, heav

tools.name: get_climate_twin
tools.description:
The large city whose climate today is most like a city's climate in 2041-2060, its climate twin: "what will Belgrade feel like in 2050". Under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5, with how alike the climates are and how much warmer and wetter or drier the city gets.

For large cities; seasonal means, not extremes

tools.name: get_place_history
tools.description:
What has hit a place before: "has Lisbon had a big earthquake", "how often do typhoons reach Manila", "what floods has Valencia had". Earthquakes, tropical cyclones, tsunamis, floods and eruptions near it: how many by decade and the largest, with date, distance, deaths and damage.

tools.name: get_hazards_near
tools.description: Disasters, hazards and official warnings happening now or recently near a place: wildfires, earthquakes, tsunamis, tropical cyclones with cone and track, floods, eruptions and volcano alert levels, ash clouds, droughts, official weather warnings and air quality. Each has the Criora Risk Index (sever

tools.name: estimate_financial_impact
tools.description:
Indicative damage to a building or asset at a place from river and coastal flooding and tropical cyclone wind: expected annual damage as a share of its value and in money, and the 50 to 500-year events, low, central and high; today, or RCP4.5 or RCP8.5 in 2050 and 2080 (wind to 2050).

Use for what

tools.name: assess_place
tools.description: Everything about one to ten places in one call: each day's risk on the dates asked (the 7-day forecast, then ECMWF ensemble chances as far as its run reaches, about two weeks, then the month's normal), hazards happening nearby, the headline long-term exposures, a home's damage band and the country's

tools.name: list_hazards
tools.description: Disasters, hazards and official warnings across a country, a region (bbox) or the whole world, most severe first by the Criora Risk Index (severity_rank) beside the issuer's own level: wildfires, earthquakes, tsunamis, tropical cyclones, floods, eruptions, volcano alert levels, ash clouds, droughts,

tools.name: rank_by_forecast
tools.description:
The cities (of 100,000 or more) or the countries where the next 1 to 7 days' weather is most dangerous, ranked by how high the risk reaches and how many people it reaches: heat, cold, wind, heavy rain, snow and freezing rain.

Use for "where will it be hottest this week", "which European cities face

tools.name: get_area_risk
tools.description: The next 1 to 7 days' weather danger over a whole country or region, day by day: the worst class reached, its hazard, the share of the area at each class, the worst point and the cities most at risk; with categories or layers, also long-term climate layers over the area (mean, 10th and 90th percenti

tools.name: get_country_profile
tools.description:
One country's climate and disaster risk, of 194: overall score 0 to 100 (higher is riskier), class and world rank, and its climate, nature, social, governance and adaptation scores. response_format=detailed adds the INFORM, ND-GAIN and World Bank indicators behind them.

Use for one country in depth

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Two to ten named countries side by side: overall risk score, class and world rank, and their climate, nature, social, governance and adaptation scores (0 to 100, higher is riskier; rank 1 is the riskiest of 194). To find the riskiest countries use rank_countries.

tools.name: rank_countries
tools.description:
The countries most or least at climate and disaster risk, overall, on one dimension or on one hazard or other indicator, optionally within a region, subregion or income group, each with its score and world rank (a filter narrows the list, not the rank).

Use for "the most climate-exposed countries",

tools.name: get_enso_outlook
tools.description:
El Niño and La Niña now and ahead: NOAA CPC's alert status and its chances of each phase for the nine seasons ahead. With a country, what each phase has brought it in each season since 1950 (its wetter or drier, warmer or colder third): tendencies of the past, not a forecast.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find Criora's documents to read and cite with fetch: a country's risk profile, a place's report, the methodology and data sources pages, and the data catalogue (climate layers, NDVI, country indicators). For an answer in one call the specific tools are shorter.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One Criora document as markdown, with the page to cite, by an id search returned: country:<ISO3>, place:<latitude>,<longitude>, page:methodology, page:sources, catalog:layers or catalog:indicators.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
